contexts.text: They call such things feculent froth.
Setting the pot empty upon the coals, that... the scum thereof may be consumed ()... An empty pot is one in which there is uncleanness and scum, that is, evil and falsity.

Woe to the city of bloods, to the pot whose scum is in it, and whose scum hath not gone forth out of it (). Here, the pot = the city or the people therein in whom is the evil of the profanation of good... The evil is the scum from it; the profanation of good is the scum which remains. (The scum in it = the external which favours filthy loves; and when this is not removed, truth is defiled. AC 10105:4.)
They cohere like the concreted froth of the sea.
Both brains... would go away into froth.
They would be cast out like froth.
Her king is as foam upon the faces of the waters ()... Foam upon the faces of the waters = what is empty and separate from truths.
He hath reduced my... fig-tree into froth ()... Froth = where there is no truth within.
To reduce the fig-tree into froth = the destruction of natural truths.
